title: flt.c_apf
description: `flt.c_apf` calculates biquad coefficients for an all-pass filter, outputting the list `b0 b1 b2 a1 a2`. Its center frequency can be specified in hertz with `@freq` (0–22050 Hz), or as angular frequency using `@rad`; the quality factor is controlled by `@q`, and the `bw` method sets bandwidth in octaves.
